summary: Submitted a final feedback-only research product carrying minimal complete learning for the end of this run, with preflight returning valid:true after fixing a single mistyped check id in ref_ids. The acceptance just before this: the review of the second verification artifact (91058714dfcf482d9bf6978402a02488) was accepted, so that second witness for c-verify-leader-voter-quorum is confirmed as well. This handoff lists the eleven confirmed obligations with the executed check that witnessed each: election-term context published below an adopted term, reproduced with both a substitute stream layer and the production TCP transport; client requests left unresolved on an inactive raft and a request accepted while leading left unresolved after shutdown; a second, different vote persisted for the same term; two leaders of one term (with the overlap-window variant as a bounded negative, holds); GetConfiguration reporting index zero for a configuration established at index one; a reported commit index naming an entry the voting quorum does not store; a leader with a reachable quorum stepping down under the lease check; the commit context below applied state on both the runtime install path and the restart-restore path; and VerifyLeader confirming leadership on non-voter acknowledgements in both the one-non-voter and two-non-voter layouts. Remaining items are stated concretely: the repair locations for the whole set are open with no source naming the intended layer; no external consumer was exercised for the client-contract findings; the campaign path of a server without a vote is not fully read even though the voter-side refusal guard is explicit; the transfer path still accepts a non-voter target and reported success with no leader established, uncovered by any obligation; and the deferred or unread surfaces remain the third-party SetHeartbeatHandler transports, the MonotonicLogStore and snapshot-compaction interplay, the nested fuzzy and raft-compat modules, and mixed reachable-voter/non-voter configurations. The product claims no map change and offers no exploration or construction run as evidence. Run state: audit spec v13, all units checked, 2 audit units, 20 experiments, 10 semantic reviews and about three minutes remaining.
